premarket.market_expectations: Markets face a short-biased session with weak global cues as US futures and Asian indices decline, while the dollar strengthens. Domestic institutional selling and rupee appreciation add pressure, though lower oil prices offer some relief. Expect defensive action given the negative overnight lead and bottom-third prior close, but normal conviction suggests limited follow-through.
